EvaluateVideoQuality.title: Video Quality Assessment
EvaluateVideoQuality.description:
## Feature Description  
Video Quality Assessment evaluates the visual quality of input videos, including general video quality and defective video quality. General video quality includes: subjective quality score, objective quality scores (definition, point noise, compression noise), and color quality scores (saturation, richness, contrast, brightness assessment), among others. Defective video quality includes: field pattern detection, scratch detection, and abnormal frame detection (stuck frames, flickering, black screen or mosaic artifacts), among others.  

For typical usage examples of this capability, see the following table:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230223/yohg/EvaluateVideoQuality.png)

> - You can obtain live human assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- This capability is available for a complete free trial on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?tagName=videorecog&children=EvaluateVideoQuality) to experience it interactively and purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or technical support for Visual Intelligence API capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API support team.

## Common Scenarios  
- **Video Quality Assessment**: A standardized set of video evaluation tools, including various no-reference metric sub-tools, serving quality monitoring needs across different business scenarios such as video transcoding, live streaming, and video enhancement.  
- **UGC Quality Review**: Ensures quality control for user-generated content (UGC) uploads by detecting video quality issues and filtering out videos with overall low quality or significant visual defects.

## Key Advantages  
- **Video Quality Evaluation**: Covers a comprehensive range of subjective and objective general video quality metrics, providing a systematic and holistic quality assessment service.  
- **Video Quality Monitoring**: Detects various technical flaws that may occur in videos, ensuring high-quality video service delivery.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete account registration.  
2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure you have activated the [Video Recognition Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videorecog). If not yet activated, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videorecog_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you must grant the RAM user the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videorecog/2020-03-20/EvaluateVideoQuality?lang=JAVA&useCommon=true) to debug the capability online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "Video Recognition (videorecog)".  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the sample code provided in the documentation.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this capability, see [Video Quality Assessment Sample Code](~~608851~~). For sample code to query asynchronous job results in common languages, see [Query Asynchronous Job Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation of this capability include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  
- **Video format**: MP4.  
- **Video size**: No larger than 1 GB.  
- **Video resolution**: No higher than 1080P, i.e., the longer edge must not exceed 1920 pixels and the shorter edge must not exceed 1080 pixels.  
- **URL address**: Must not contain Chinese characters.

## Billing Information  
For details on the metering method and pricing of Video Quality Assessment, see [Billing Overview](~~202485~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API.

## Invocation Steps

RecognizeVideoCastCrewList.description:
## Feature Description  
The video OCR capability detects text in videos, covering multiple scenarios such as news, movies and TV series, entertainment, and sports. It supports recognition of Chinese and English text, both simplified and traditional characters, scores, and more. It also handles various text types, including standard captions, static captions, scrolling captions, partial natural scene text, vertical text, and stylized fonts.

> - You can obtain live human assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=videorecog&children=RecognizeVideoCastCrewList) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase the service online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or technical support for Visual Intelligence API capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API support team.

## Common Scenarios  

- **Subtitle Recognition**: Detects dubbed subtitles in long-form videos such as movies and TV series, including UNIX timestamps and corresponding text content. This enables use cases like external subtitle generation and sensitive content review.  
- **Cast and Crew List Recognition**: Identifies cast and crew information from rolling end credits in movies and TV shows, supporting video metadata verification and queries for sensitive individuals.  
- **Sports Text Recognition**: Detects text in sports broadcasts, such as scores and advertisement text, enabling applications like match status analysis and advertisement monitoring.

## Key Advantages  

- **Broad Video Type Support**: Compatible with a wide range of video formats.  
- **Diverse Text Type Support**: Handles standard captions, static captions, scrolling captions, partial natural scene text, vertical text, and stylized fonts.  
- **High Accuracy**: Delivers reliable recognition accuracy even in low-resolution videos or complex scenes.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the top-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the prompts to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure you have activated the [Video Understanding Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videorecog). If not yet activated, click [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videorecog_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the RAM user the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videorecog/2020-03-20/RecognizeVideoCastCrewList?lang=JAVA) to debug the capability online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the video understanding (videorecog) category.  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the provided sample code.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [Video OCR Sample Code](~~477832~~). For examples on querying asynchronous task results, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common direct invocation methods for this capability include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  

- **Video formats**: AVI, FLV, MKV, MPG, MP4, TS, MOV, MXF.  
- **Encoding formats**: MPEG-2, MPEG-4, H.264, H.265/HEVC.  
- **Video size**: No larger than 10 GB.  
- **Video resolution**: Not lower than 240P.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  
- **Recommended video duration**: No longer than 30 minutes; otherwise, processing may fail due to timeout.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of video OCR, see [Billing Overview](~~202485~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API.

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two-step invocation:  
1. Call the RecognizeVideoCastCrewList API to commit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. If the job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again.

SplitVideoParts.title: Video splitting
SplitVideoParts.description:
## Feature Description  
The video splitting feature analyzes and understands videos from multiple dimensions, decomposing a video into multiple segments and returning the boundary timestamps of each segment (without returning the actual video clips). It also generates summary descriptions for each segment. The splitting dimensions include shot and subject, among others.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- This feature is available for a complete free trial on Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?spm=a2cvz.27764832.J_7524944390.8.5f1250b5aWPQQw&tagName=videorecog&children=SplitVideoParts) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase the service online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or other issues related to Visual Intelligence API, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact the Visual Intelligence API support team.

## Common Scenarios  
Media and entertainment material production: Supports intelligent information analysis and segment splitting of media and entertainment videos, applicable to scenarios such as full-segment splitting and distribution of long-form videos, rapid editing material generation, and video editing.

## Key Advantages  

- **Supports multidimensional information extraction**: Extracts information across multiple dimensions and performs segment splitting based on this information.  
- **Fine-grained splitting**: Enables second-level or frame-level splitting of materials.  
- **Provides segment summaries**: Generates summary descriptions for each split segment.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the feature**: Ensure that you have activated the [Video Recognition service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videorecog). If not, activate it immediately by clicking [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videorecog_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you must grant the RAM user the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videorecog/2020-03-20/SplitVideoParts?lang=JAVA) to debug the feature online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the Video Recognition (videorecog) category.  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages for this feature, see [Video Splitting Sample Code](~~2261132~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results in common languages, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation of this feature include the following:  
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation from Android client](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation from iOS client](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  
- **Video formats**: AVI, FLV, MKV, MPG, MP4, TS, MOV, MXF.  
- **Video size**: Less than 4 GB.  
- **Video duration**: No longer than 3 hours.  
- **Video resolution**: Between 240P and 1440P (inclusive).  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of video splitting, see [Billing Overview](~~202485~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API.

## Invocation Steps  
This feature is asynchronous and requires two-step invocation:  
1. Call the SplitVideoParts API to commit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again.

UnderstandVideoContent.title: Video Content Understanding
UnderstandVideoContent.description:
## Service Description  
Due to adjustments in product operations, the Video Content Understanding service will no longer accept new user activations or API invocations effective immediately. Existing users who previously activated this service may continue using it. The service will be delisted on April 20, 2026, after which neither new nor existing users will be able to invoke it. Please identify an alternative solution as soon as possible. If you have any questions about using the Video Content Understanding API, you can search for the DingTalk group (23109592) and join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform support group to contact us.

## Feature Description  
The Video Content Understanding capability can analyze various elements in videos, such as celebrities, ordinary people, and game scenes.

> - You can access [online consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to receive live assistance.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, interface usage, or technical support for visual AI capabilities on the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, please join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform support group via DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
Internet Ad Effectiveness Analysis: Analyzes the relationship between internet ad content and effectiveness, helping customers significantly improve Ad Effectiveness.

## Key Advantages  
Supports analysis of various complex scenarios, such as scenes containing both celebrities and ordinary people.

## Input Restrictions  
- Video formats: MP4, AVI, FLV, MOV.  
- Video size: No more than 1 GB.  
- Video duration: No longer than 5 minutes. If the video exceeds this limit, only the analysis results for the first 5 minutes will be returned.  
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

## Security Statement  
- Ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during debugging are valid for 1 hour and will be automatically cleaned up and deleted by the system after 24 hours.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of Video Content Understanding, see [Billing Overview](~~202485~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API.

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps to invoke.

In the first step, invoke the UnderstandVideoContent API to commit a Job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a Job ID.

In the second step, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the Job ID to check the Job execution Status and Result. If the Job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. We recommend not submitting duplicate Jobs for the same task until its processing is complete.

For example, if the total video duration is 20 seconds, [[0,0.1],[0.3,1.0]] means the element appears twice: first from 0 to 2 seconds, and second from 6 to 20 seconds. | | TimeProportion | float | Yes | 80 | Indicates the percentage of the total video duration during which the element appears.
